body.statement: Under \(\text{ass:iid-sampling}\), the finite observed-cell histogram satisfies \[\sqrt n(\widehat o_n-o)\Rightarrow N(0,\operatorname{diag}(o)-oo^\top).\]

source.locator: Theorem 2.27, specialized by the Cram\'er--Wold device to bounded categorical indicator vectors
source.verbatim_statement: Proposition 2.27 (Lindeberg–Feller central limit theorem). For each n let Y_{n,1}, …, Y_{n,k_n} be independent random vectors with finite variances such that ∑_{i=1}^{k_n} E‖Y_{n,i}‖² 1{‖Y_{n,i}‖ > ε} → 0, every ε > 0, and ∑_{i=1}^{k_n} Cov Y_{n,i} → Σ. Then the sequence ∑_{i=1}^{k_n} (Y_{n,i} − E Y_{n,i}) converges in distribution to N(0, Σ).
